name: Scoda Tubes Limited
summary: Scoda Tubes Limited manufactures and sells stainless steel pipes and tubes in India and internationally. The company provides stainless steel seamless and welded pipes, tubes, and u tubes. The company serves food and beverage, automobile, chemical, oil and gas, construction, infrastructure, and automobile industries. Scoda Tubes Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is based in Mehsana, India.
